title: moderation.completed
description: A moderation case was resolved and its verdict is now a fact. Contract owned by the emitter (the moderation module); this file is stapel-reviews' reader of it. When target_type names this module's registration (STAPEL_REVIEWS.MODERATION_TARGET_TYPE, default "review") the target_key is a review id and the verdict is applied to that review's visibility as the system actor. Required here is only what the consumer reads — a consumer that demanded every field the emitter happens to send would break the day the emitter adds one, which is exactly the trap additionalProperties:false set for stapel-listings.
